scope: multi-round greedy cache/feature commit review; no GPU claims

cases.setup: Anchor plus 3 extra rows, draft[0] accepted, draft[1] mismatches
cases.must: commit anchor, draft[0], and the bonus token exactly once; next anchor is the bonus; hidden later-row KV/GDN/features never leak into canonical state
commit 8 tokens but only prefixes/features through the bonus row; the bonus's own logits/state are computed in the next round, not fabricated

cases.setup: DFlash width 8, draft[1] mismatches while draft[2..6] also match
cases.must: stop at draft[1]; later matches do not extend acceptance; width stays 8; target verification prefix may be 4 or 8 consistently

cases.setup: Round A commits 5 rows (prefix 5), round B verifies target prefix 4
cases.must: B's anchor position equals A's committed length; caches come from A's committed prefix, not A's last computed row

cases.setup: Round A accepts only anchor+bonus (count 2), round B requests prefix 8
cases.must: B reads prefix from count 2 and appends 7 inputs; no stale rows from A's private prefix 8

cases.setup: Corrected bonus row or next draft equals an earlier draft token
cases.must: select by position/count, never by first occurrence of a token ID

cases.setup: Bonus or an accepted draft reaches EOS/output cap
cases.must: truncate emitted tokens, prefixes, and feature rows to the same committed count; caller owns handling; no post-cap inputs committed
features.shape[0] equals selected prefix count and every row belongs to that request's same private prefix; no cross-request or unaccepted-row reuse

cases.setup: Selector rejects width 8 and retries width 4, or a round fails admission
cases.must: rejections/failures do not increment caches, positions, counters, or acceptance stats; no partial canonical commit before a complete round
measured cost covers the full round including commit/features/sync and labels whether 4 or 8 was verified; no whole-block charge for prefix 4 and no kernel-only gain claim

cases.setup: Bonus emitted, then commit cache and features
cases.must: next round's anchor/position equals the number of tokens committed, including the bonus; cache and features commit atomically with token emission order

cases.setup: Mismatch at position j; later positions match
cases.must: record only positions <= accepted as observations; later positions are censored, not failures and not accepts; no posterior confidence claim
